hero.emblemAlt: A golden arm raising a skull, wrapped in a green ribbon
hero.eyebrow: Arcana Subclass · XIII · Death · Aspect of Sorrow

epigraph.html: We have crossed our own ending, and the Weave turns every wound we take into strength.

hero.ledeHtml: Mystra wove the Eternal from an ending they refused to accept, a thread that crossed death and came back changed. They take the blows meant for others and grow harder to kill for it, draining the life from their foes and calling the grave to finish what their hammer began. The Eternal stands in the front line in armour, swings a hammer or a maul twice a turn and adds Necrotic damage to every hit. The more it bleeds in a fight, the stronger it becomes: losing hit points is how it awakens its Aspect. Pick it if you want to be the wall your party hides behind, and the one that does not fall.

blocks.html:
The thirteenth card of the Major Arcana is Death. It usually shows a skeleton in black armour riding a pale horse and carrying a banner marked with a white rose. Kings and beggars fall before it alike, and behind it the sun rises between two towers.

For all its look, the card almost never means a death. It means an ending: a door that closes so that another can open, a life that has to finish before the next one starts. The rider does not stop; it passes through, and what it leaves behind is never the same.

That is the Eternal. Its life reached the end that every life reaches, and Mystra did not let it break. The Eternal walked through its own death and came back on the other side, carrying the grief of it as a weapon. It does not fear the blow that should kill it. It counts it.

upright.title: Upright
upright.html: The Eternal lives through what should have been its end and comes back harder. Every wound it takes is counted towards its Awakening.

reversed.title: Reversed
reversed.html: Enemies live the reversed card: their wounds fester with disease and stored pain, Darkness Rise slows them to a crawl, and fear roots them where they stand.

blocks.html: You are the front line. Walk into the enemy, pull the ones that run back to you with Death's Grasp, and strike with Obliterate or two weapon attacks. Bonus actions open wounds with Blood Reaper or wrap you in Indestructible. You are meant to be hit: every hit point you lose brings the Aspect of Sorrow closer, and once it wakes, the enemies around you rot in Darkness Rise while you turn your pain on them with The Final Toll. Transfusion and temporary hit points keep you standing long enough to finish the job.

blocks.title: At a Glance
blocks.html:
• Role: frontline juggernaut and necromantic bruiser.
  • Strengths: armour and shields, temporary hit points, life drain, resistances and immunities, Extra Attack with Necrotic damage on top, and an Awakening that grows by itself on the front line.
  • Weaknesses: no way to move itself beyond walking, little support for allies besides Death Ward, thin utility outside combat, and a careful party that keeps it unhurt delays its Aspect.
  • Tip: Immortal Blood and Inescapable Destruction can be cast before a fight. They cost no action and last until combat ends.

rows.label: Hit Points
rows.html: 6 + your Constitution modifier at level 1, then 4 + your Constitution modifier per level

rows.label: Armour
rows.html: Light Armour, Medium Armour, Heavy Armour, Shields

rows.label: Weapons
rows.html: Light Hammers, Clubs, Maces, Greatclubs, Warhammers, Mauls

rows.label: Skills
rows.html: Choose 4 from Athletics, Arcana, History, Intimidation, Medicine, Nature, Religion and Survival. Then gain Expertise in 2 of them.

rows.label: Suggested Abilities
rows.html: Strength 13 · Dexterity 8 · Constitution 15 · Intelligence 15 · Wisdom 10 · Charisma 10, then +2 and +1 to two abilities

rows.html: Eternal's Plate (Breastplate, Armour Class 16), Maul, Shoes, 2 Potions of Healing, Scroll of Revivify, camp clothes

intro.html: This table shows the Eternal's own features. You also gain every feature of the base class: see Arcana Progression. All Eternal spells are Always Prepared and are cast with a Woven Spell Slot of your current Slot Level.

blocks.html:
The Eternal keeps count of what a fight takes from it. From level 3, every hit point you lose to damage during combat is added to a total of hit points lost this combat. Healing does not lower it: you can fall to half, heal back to full, and the loss still stands. The hit points you pay for Blood Offering count too.

The total is measured against your hit point maximum. Lose 30% and you awaken Tier I of the Aspect of Sorrow; 50% awakens Tier II; 70% awakens Tier III. Each tier also needs its level (3, 7 and 12), and each one stacks on the last. Everything resets when combat ends, so every fight starts from zero.

Example: an Eternal with 60 maximum hit points
GoalShareHit points lostAwakens
Tier I30%18Sorrow: you emanate Darkness Rise and gain The Final Toll
Tier II50%30Mourning: you drop to 1 hit point instead of 0, once; isolated enemies suffer Dread
Tier III70%42Aspect of Sorrow: +3 Constitution and Harvest

blocks.title: Awakening Progress
blocks.html: While a tier is still ahead of you, the status Awakening Progress shows how far you are towards it, in percent. It counts only the stretch between one goal and the next: after Sorrow at 30%, losing 40% of your hit point maximum reads as 50% towards Mourning.

Paying in blood

Several Eternal tools grow with your hit points, which makes Constitution worth more than it looks. Blood Offering costs a tenth of your hit point maximum and feeds the count directly. Darkness Rise deals 10% of your hit point maximum to every enemy in its aura each turn. The Final Toll deals damage equal to the hit points you have lost this combat, up to half your hit point maximum, so it hits hardest once you have bled past Mourning.

Staying standing

Losing hit points on purpose only works if you survive it. The Eternal layers its defences so the loss is slow and the last blow never lands.

DefenceLevelWhat it does
Transfusion1Regain hit points equal to the Necrotic damage it deals.
Indestructible3Temporary hit points equal to 5 × your Arcana level, then a heal of 2 × your Arcana level.
Immortal Blood3Immune to Disease, Bleeding and Gaping Wounds.
Unbroken7Half damage from non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing while above 80% of your maximum hit points.
Mourning7Once per fight, drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
Inured to Undeath11Resistant to Necrotic damage; your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.
Unbroken guards the top fifth of your health. Once your losses pass 20% of your hit point maximum it stops helping, so it does its work early in a fight, before Sorrow wakes.

features.name: Blood Reaper
features.bodyHtml: On a hit, the target is Bleeding for 2 turns: it takes 2 Slashing damage at the start of each turn and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws. Healing removes it.

features.name: Obliterate
features.bodyHtml:
Strike an enemy with your weapon, dealing an additional 1d8 Necrotic damage.

Make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, it deals your weapon's damage plus 1d8 Necrotic.

At higher levels: 2d8 with a level 2 slot, 3d8 with a level 3 slot, 4d8 with a level 4 slot, 5d8 with a level 5 slot, 6d8 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Transfusion
features.bodyHtml:
Siphon the life force of an enemy, dealing damage and regaining as many hit points.

On a hit, deals 1d6 Necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to the damage dealt.

At higher levels: 2d6 with a level 2 slot, 3d6 with a level 3 slot, 4d6 with a level 4 slot, 5d6 with a level 5 slot, 6d6 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Dead Whispers
features.bodyHtml:
Grant a semblance of life to a humanoid corpse, allowing it to answer up to 5 questions.

Skeletons and creatures killed with Acid, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic or Radiant damage no longer have a mouth and can't be made to talk. Doesn't work on Undead or beasts.

features.name: 13 - Death: Awakening
features.bodyHtml:
Lose hit points during a fight to awaken the Aspect of Sorrow until combat ends. Healing doesn't undo the loss. Each goal you reach awakens one more tier.

Level 3: lose 30% of your hit point maximum to gain Sorrow. Level 7: lose 50% to also gain Mourning. Level 12: lose 70% to awaken as the Aspect of Sorrow. See Sorrow and Aspect of Sorrow.

features.name: Death's Grasp
features.bodyHtml:
Pull a creature 5m towards you, dealing 1d8 Necrotic damage.

If the target fails the Saving Throw, it is pulled 5m towards you and takes 1d8 Necrotic damage. On a success, nothing happens.

At higher levels: 2d8 with a level 3 slot, 3d8 with a level 4 slot, 4d8 with a level 5 slot, 5d8 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Indestructible
features.bodyHtml:
Call upon your undying nature to gain temporary hit points for 2 turns. At the end of the duration, or when the temporary hit points are removed, regain hit points.

Gain temporary hit points equal to 5 × your Arcana level for 2 turns. When the duration ends, or the temporary hit points are gone, you regain hit points equal to 2 × your Arcana level. At level 3 that is 15 temporary hit points and a heal of 6.

At higher levels: no change; the values follow your level, not the slot.

features.name: Immortal Blood

stats.label: Duration
stats.value: Until Long Rest or combat ends

features.bodyHtml:
Let death's patience settle in your veins.

You gain Immortal Blood: your blood defies corruption. You are Immune to Disease, Bleeding and Gaping Wounds. Can be cast outside combat; it ends when your next combat does.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.bodyHtml: Can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack. If you gain the Extra Attack feature from more than one class, they don't add together.

features.name: Death Ward
features.bodyHtml:
Death is your domain. Protect an ally from it.

Touch an ally other than yourself. The next time damage would reduce the ally to 0 hit points, they remain conscious with 1 hit point left. Once per Short Rest.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction

stats.label: Duration
stats.value: Until Long Rest or combat ends

features.bodyHtml:
Bind your necrotic power to the end of all things.

You gain Inescapable Destruction: spells you cast ignore Resistance to Necrotic damage. Can be cast outside combat; it ends when your next combat does.

features.name: Mourning
features.bodyHtml: Unlocks Tier II of the Aspect of Sorrow. Once you have lost 50% of your hit point maximum in a fight, the first time you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead, and an isolated enemy within 3m of you has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you. See Aspect of Sorrow.

features.name: Unbroken

stats.label: Duration
stats.value: Until Long Rest or combat ends

features.bodyHtml:
Harden your flesh against the living world.

You gain Unbroken: unbroken and unyielding, you take half damage from all non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage while above 80% of your maximum hit points.

features.name: Blood Offering

stats.label: Duration
stats.value: Until the end of your turn

features.bodyHtml:
Open your veins to the dark.

Lose a tenth of your hit point maximum as Necrotic damage, and your Arcane spells and cantrips deal an additional 2d8 Necrotic until the end of your turn. The hit points you lose count towards Sorrow.

At higher levels: 3d8 with a level 4 slot, 4d8 with a level 5 slot, 5d8 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Death's Aspect
features.bodyHtml:
Let your fearsome presence erupt in a menacing pulse, Frightening nearby enemies.

Each enemy within 9m that fails the Saving Throw is Frightened for 2 turns: it can't move and has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.

features.name: Hemoplague
features.bodyHtml:
Poison the blood of a target and possibly afflict it with a disease of your choice.

When you cast it, choose one of six diseases. On a hit, the target becomes Hemoplague Poisoned: Stage 1: it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks. Each turn it must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw against your spell save DC, or the poisoning worsens to Stage 2, then Stage 3. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease you chose.

DiseaseEffect
Blinding SicknessDisadvantage on Wisdom Checks and Saving Throws, and Blinded.
Filth FeverDisadvantage on Strength Checks, Saving Throws and Attack Rolls that use Strength.
Flesh RotDisadvantage on Charisma Checks and Vulnerability to all damage.
MindfireDisadvantage on Intelligence Checks and Saving Throws, and Befuddled.
SeizureDisadvantage on Dexterity Checks, Saving Throws and Attack Rolls.
Slimy DoomDisadvantage on Constitution Checks and Saving Throws. Whenever it is hit, it becomes Stunned.

At higher levels: no change.

features.name: Hemorrhage
features.bodyHtml:
Sculpt a massive sphere of entropic energy in a target location. Devastate the area and all surrounding creatures, inflicting Hemorrhage and Gaping Wounds upon them for 2 turns.

Every creature in the area that is not your ally takes 2d10 Necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful Saving Throw. Either way, it suffers Gaping Wounds and Hemorrhage for 2 turns.

While Hemorrhage lasts, every hit point the creature loses, from any source, is stored. When it ends, the creature takes the whole stored amount again as Necrotic damage.

features.name: Inured to Undeath

stats.label: Duration
stats.value: Until Long Rest or combat ends

features.bodyHtml:
Close your soul to the grave's touch.

You gain Inured to Undeath: you have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are Resistant to Necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.

features.name: Aspect of Sorrow
features.bodyHtml: Unlocks Tier III of the Aspect of Sorrow. Once you have lost 70% of your hit point maximum in a fight, your Constitution increases by 3, and once per turn, when a hostile creature dies within 9m of you, you gain an additional action. See Aspect of Sorrow.

features.name: Realm of Death
features.bodyHtml:
Bring one enemy to the realm of death, Banishing all other creatures nearby.

Every other creature nearby is Banished for 3 turns, leaving you alone with your target. For 4 turns the realm of death, a region of cold blackness, fills everything within 6m of the spot: inside it the enemy is Vulnerable to Necrotic damage, takes 2d6 Cold damage at the start of its turn and 2d6 Acid damage at the end of its turn, and the area is Difficult Terrain.

blocks.html: From level 3, the Eternal awakens the Aspect of Death, the Aspect of Sorrow, by suffering. What is counted is the share of your hit point maximum you have lost during the current fight, and healing never takes it back (see Sorrow). Each goal you reach awakens one more tier, as long as your level allows it. The tiers stack and last until combat ends; while awakened you carry the status 13 - Death: Awakened I, II or III.

tiers.label: Tier I · Sorrow
tiers.goal: Lose 30% of your hit point maximum · level 3
itemsHtml: You emanate Darkness Rise, a 3m aura of decay. Your movement speed increases by 50%.
Each enemy that stays in the aura takes Necrotic damage equal to 10% of your maximum hit points at the start of its turn, and its movement speed is halved.
You gain the Aspect spell The Final Toll.

tiers.label: Tier II · Mourning
itemsHtml: The first time you would drop to 0 hit points this fight, you drop to 1 instead.
An isolated enemy within 3m of you suffers Dread: it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

tiers.label: Tier III · Aspect of Sorrow
itemsHtml: Harvest: once per turn, when a hostile creature dies within 9m of you, you gain an additional action.

feature.name: The Final Toll
feature.bodyHtml:
Turn your suffering on a foe.

Deals Necrotic damage equal to the hit points you have lost this combat, up to half your hit point maximum. A creature killed this way rises as a zombie. Available only while the Aspect is awakened, and costs no Woven Spell Slot.
